subject: Coord: Redwood demo with Integrity Health — balancing ET/CET windows
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@integrityhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kristin Lowe <kristin.lowe@integrityhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:25:00 -0500
Subject: Demo request — Integrity Health + Redwood (preferred morning ET)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the intro yesterday. Our product and clinical leaders would like a focused walkthrough of the Redwood inference platform next week so we can validate latency and multiregion behavior for a pilot.

Preferred window: Wed 17 Nov between 08:00–10:00 ET (we need it before our 11:00 leadership sync). If that is impossible for the EU-serving engineers, please tell us the latest you can stretch into the morning ET slot. We can do 30–45 minutes.

Two asks:
- A 30-min demo focused on latency, routing/fallbacks, and private deployment options
- A recording if part of our team can’t join live

Thanks — Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Engineering
Integrity Health
Phone: +1 (617) 555-0123

Attachments: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@integrityhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 17:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo request — Integrity Health + Redwood (preferred morning ET)

Thanks Alex — Jordan here. Really appreciate the clarity on goals.

Quick note on scheduling: our EU engineering crew is based in CET and we have an internal on-call rotation that makes some early-ET slots difficult for hands-on demos. Also, with recent DST shifts some of our participants' calendars showed mixed offsets, so I want to avoid any confusion.

Options we can offer next week:
- Option A: Wed 17 Nov 09:00 ET / 15:00 CET — 30–45m (hands-on engineers on call)
- Option B: Wed 17 Nov 12:30 ET / 18:30 CET — 45m (compromise slot; a little late CET but preferred for full dev presence)
- Option C: Record-only session at 08:00 ET with a 20–30m Q&A live at a later time (if recording meets your needs)

If you can confirm Option A or B I’ll block the calendar and include a short agenda. If you need strict 08:00 ET we’ll do Option C and follow up with a live Q&A.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 00:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Demo request — Integrity Health + Redwood (preferred morning ET)

On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 5:10 PM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Options we can offer next week:
> - Option A: Wed 17 Nov 09:00 ET / 15:00 CET — 30–45m (hands-on engineers on call)
> - Option B: Wed 17 Nov 12:30 ET / 18:30 CET — 45m (compromise slot; a little late CET but preferred for full dev presence)

Jordan — quick heads up from the EU side: 15:00 CET is ok but our lead backend eng has a recurring workshop until 15:30 that day. We can make Option B work (18:30 CET), but it is late and a few folks will be joining from home. If you expect heavy live troubleshooting, Option B gives better coverage.

If we go Option B, please confirm we can keep it to 45 minutes and provide an agenda plus the specific recording permission (some EU contributors need explicit consent before being recorded).

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Product Manager, EU Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@integrityhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kristin Lowe <kristin.lowe@integrityhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo request — Integrity Health + Redwood (preferred morning ET)

Thanks Jordan and Kim — we can be flexible. Option B (12:30 ET / 18:30 CET) is acceptable if you can do 45 minutes and record. Two clarifications:
1) Recording consent: please confirm Redwood can record and we can use the recording internally; we don’t need to publish it externally.
2) Agenda: short agenda please — 3 items max (latency demo, routing/fallbacks, private deploy Q&A).

If that works, Kristin will accept the invite.

—Alex

On a separate note, we have a brief security checklist that might arrive from procurement separately — we’ll loop you in if that comes through before the demo.
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@integrityhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo request — Integrity Health + Redwood (preferred morning ET)

Alex — perfect, thanks for the quick decision.

We will do Option B (Wed 17 Nov, 12:30–13:15 ET / 18:30–19:15 CET).
- Recording: confirmed — Redwood will record the session for internal use and won’t publish externally without explicit permission.
- Agenda (attached): 1) Live latency walkthrough (10m) 2) Routing, fallback, and multiregion behavior (20m) 3) Private deployment and Q&A (15m)

I’ve attached a short agenda (demo-agenda-IntegrityHealth.pdf) and will send a calendar invite (redwood-demo-invite.ics) in a follow-up; invite will include a Drive link to the lab notes. If procurement sends the security checklist, please put it in the same thread and we’ll route it to our compliance team (Marissa copied).

If anything changes, ping me and we’ll adapt. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-ih-20261117
Attachments: demo-agenda-IntegrityHealth.pdf, redwood-demo-invite.ics
